tools.name: talero_get_company
tools.description: Get the company the API key is bound to: name, CVR, VAT registration status, and whether the key is a sandbox (test) key. Talero API: GET /v1/company.

tools.name: talero_list_customers
tools.description: List customers, filterable by date range and free text, sortable by name, created_at or email. Talero API: GET /v1/customers.

tools.name: talero_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id, with contact, CVR and payment-terms fields. Talero API: GET /v1/customers/{id}.

tools.name: talero_lookup_customer
tools.description: Find customers by exact CVR number, email or phone. Give at least one. Talero API: GET /v1/customers/lookup.

tools.name: talero_list_invoices
tools.description: List sales invoices, filterable by status (draft, approved, sent, paid, overdue, cancelled, credit_note), date range and free text. Talero API: GET /v1/invoices.

tools.name: talero_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id, with its lines, totals, status and invoice number. Talero API: GET /v1/invoices/{id}.

tools.name: talero_create_invoice_draft
tools.description: Create a DRAFT sales invoice. The draft gets no invoice number and is not posted to the ledger; approve and send it in Talero. Lines need description, quantity and unit_price; vat_rate defaults to 25. Talero API: POST /v1/invoices without auto_approve.

tools.name: talero_list_expenses
tools.description: List expenses (purchase costs), filterable by status (pending, approved, paid), date range and free text. Talero API: GET /v1/expenses.

tools.name: talero_get_expense
tools.description: Get one expense by id, with amount, VAT, date, supplier and voucher link. Talero API: GET /v1/expenses/{id}.

tools.name: talero_list_products
tools.description: List products and services with unit prices and VAT rates, sortable by name, created_at or unit_price. Talero API: GET /v1/products.

tools.name: talero_get_product
tools.description: Get one product by id, with price, unit, SKU and VAT rate. Talero API: GET /v1/products/{id}.

tools.name: talero_list_suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers (creditors), filterable by date range and free text, sortable by name or created_at. Talero API: GET /v1/suppliers.

tools.name: talero_get_supplier
tools.description: Get one supplier by id, with contact and CVR fields. Talero API: GET /v1/suppliers/{id}.

tools.name: talero_list_accounts
tools.description: List accounts of the chart of accounts (account number, name, type, VAT code), sortable by account_number, name or created_at. Talero API: GET /v1/accounts.

tools.name: talero_list_transactions
tools.description: List ledger transactions (journal entries) by date range, newest first by default. Talero API: GET /v1/transactions.

tools.name: talero_get_voucher
tools.description: Get voucher (bilag) metadata by id: file name, type, date and linked entries. The document file itself is not returned. Talero API: GET /v1/vouchers/{id}.

tools.name: talero_get_balance_sheet
tools.description: Get the balance sheet for a period. Talero API: GET /v1/reports/balance.

tools.name: talero_get_profit_loss
tools.description: Get the profit and loss report for a period. Talero API: GET /v1/reports/profit-loss.

tools.name: talero_create_customer
tools.description: Create a customer. Only name is required. Talero API: POST /v1/customers.

tools.name: talero_update_customer
tools.description: Update a customer. Fields you omit keep their current value: the server reads the record first, merges your changes, then saves it. Talero API: GET then PUT /v1/customers/{id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: talero_list_customers, talero_lookup_customer · Private data: talero_get_company, talero_get_customer, talero_get_supplier, talero_get_voucher, talero_update_customer · Public sink: talero_list_customers, talero_lookup_customer, talero_create_invoice_draft, talero_create_customer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: talero_list_customers, talero_lookup_customer · Private data: talero_get_company, talero_get_customer, talero_get_supplier, talero_get_voucher, talero_update_customer · Public sink: talero_list_customers, talero_lookup_customer, talero_create_invoice_draft, talero_create_customer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
